ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the input x[n] enters the upper-left adder; the output of this adder passes successively through two cascaded z^{-1} delay units along the right vertical branch. The intermediate node after the first delay unit is fed back leftward through gain 1 to the left middle adder, and at the same time enters the output adder rightward through gain -5/3. The lower node after the second delay unit is fed back leftward through gain -2/9 to the left middle adder, and at the same time enters the output adder rightward through gain 5/3. The output of the left middle adder is then sent upward into the upper-left adder, and the right adder output is y[n]. Reasoning: Let W(z) be the output of the upper-left adder, that is, the signal before entering the first z^{-1} delay. From the feedback paths in the figure, the signal after the first delay is z^{-1}W(z), and the signal after the second delay is z^{-2}W(z). The quantity fed back to the input adder is z^{-1}W(z)-(2/9)z^{-2}W(z), so W(z)=X(z)+z^{-1}W(z)-(2/9)z^{-2}W(z). Therefore W(z)/X(z)=1/(1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2}). The output adder receives two signals: the intermediate node through -5/3, and the bottom node through 5/3, so Y(z)=(-5/3)z^{-1}W(z)+(5/3)z^{-2}W(z). The system function is H(z)=Y(z)/X(z)=[-(5/3)z^{-1}+(5/3)z^{-2}]/[1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2}]. When x[n]=u[n], X(z)=1/(1-z^{-1}). Thus Y(z)=H(z)X(z)=[-(5/3)z^{-1}(1-z^{-1})]/[(1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2})(1-z^{-1})]. Cancel the common factor (1-z^{-1}), and factor the denominator as 1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2}=(1-z^{-1}/3)(1-2z^{-1}/3), obtaining Y(z)= [-(5/3)z^{-1}]/[(1-z^{-1}/3)(1-2z^{-1}/3)]. The partial fraction decomposition is Y(z)=5/(1-z^{-1}/3)-5/(1-2z^{-1}/3). Taking the inverse Z-transform gives y[n]=5(1/3)^n u[n]-5(2/3)^n u[n].

W(z)=X(z)+z^{-1}W(z)-(2/9)z^{-2}W(z).
因此
W(z)/X(z)=1/(1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2}).

Y(z)=(-5/3)z^{-1}W(z)+(5/3)z^{-2}W(z).
系统函数为
H(z)=Y(z)/X(z)=[-(5/3)z^{-1}+(5/3)z^{-2}]/[1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2}].
当 x[n]=u[n] 时，X(z)=1/(1-z^{-1})。于是
Y(z)=H(z)X(z)=[-(5/3)z^{-1}(1-z^{-1})]/[(1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2})(1-z^{-1})].
约去公共因子 (1-z^{-1})，并将分母因式分解为
1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2}=(1-z^{-1}/3)(1-2z^{-1}/3),
得到
Y(z)= [-(5/3)z^{-1}]/[(1-z^{-1}/3)(1-2z^{-1}/3)].
部分分式分解为
Y(z)=5/(1-z^{-1}/3)-5/(1-2z^{-1}/3).
反 Z 变换得到
 y[n]=5(1/3)^n u[n]-5(2/3)^n u[n].

With zero initial state, the diagram gives a[n+1]=x[n]+a[n]-(2/9)b[n], b[n+1]=a[n], and y[n]=-(5/3)a[n]+(5/3)b[n]. For x[n]=u[n], solve the constant-input state recursion. The state matrix has characteristic polynomial lambda^2-lambda+2/9=(lambda-1/3)(lambda-2/3), so any zero-steady-output response must be a combination C(1/3)^n+D(2/3)^n. The steady state has a=b, so the output steady term is zero. Use rest initial conditions: a[0]=b[0]=0 gives y[0]=0, and a[1]=1, b[1]=0 gives y[1]=-5/3. Thus C+D=0 and C/3+2D/3=-5/3, giving C=5 and D=-5. Hence y[n]=5(1/3)^n u[n]-5(2/3)^n u[n].

推理：令 a[n] 为第一个 z^{-1} 块后的信号，b[n] 为第二个 z^{-1} 块后的信号。零初始状态下，由框图得到状态方程：a[n+1]=x[n]+a[n]-(2/9)b[n]，b[n+1]=a[n]，输出方程为 y[n]=-(5/3)a[n]+(5/3)b[n]。当 x[n]=u[n] 时，对 n>=0 是常值输入 1。系统矩阵的特征多项式为 lambda^2-lambda+2/9=(lambda-1/3)(lambda-2/3)，所以暂态由 (1/3)^n 和 (2/3)^n 组成。稳态时 a=b，因而 y_ss=-(5/3)a+(5/3)b=0，因此 y[n]=C(1/3)^n+D(2/3)^n。由零初始条件 a[0]=b[0]=0 得 y[0]=0，所以 C+D=0。又 a[1]=1，b[1]=0，得 y[1]=-5/3，所以 C/3+2D/3=-5/3。解得 C=5，D=-5。因此 y[n]=5(1/3)^n u[n]-5(2/3)^n u[n]。

raw_record.original_question: For the stable discrete-time system realization shown in the figure, what is the response \(y[n]\) when the input is the unit step sequence \(x[n] = u[n]\)?
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, the input x[n] enters the upper-left adder; the output of this adder passes successively through two cascaded z^{-1} delay units along the right vertical branch. The intermediate node after the first delay unit is fed back leftward through gain 1 to the left middle adder, and at the same time enters the output adder rightward through gain -5/3. The lower node after the second delay unit is fed back leftward through gain -2/9 to the left middle adder, and at the same time enters the output adder rightward through gain 5/3. The output of the left middle adder is then sent upward into the upper-left adder, and the right adder output is y[n].

Reasoning: Let W(z) be the output of the upper-left adder, that is, the signal before entering the first z^{-1} delay. From the feedback paths in the figure, the signal after the first delay is z^{-1}W(z), and the signal after the second delay is z^{-2}W(z). The quantity fed back to the input adder is z^{-1}W(z)-(2/9)z^{-2}W(z), so
W(z)=X(z)+z^{-1}W(z)-(2/9)z^{-2}W(z).
Therefore
W(z)/X(z)=1/(1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2}).
The output adder receives two signals: the intermediate node through -5/3, and the bottom node through 5/3, so
Y(z)=(-5/3)z^{-1}W(z)+(5/3)z^{-2}W(z).
The system function is
H(z)=Y(z)/X(z)=[-(5/3)z^{-1}+(5/3)z^{-2}]/[1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2}].
When x[n]=u[n], X(z)=1/(1-z^{-1}). Thus
Y(z)=H(z)X(z)=[-(5/3)z^{-1}(1-z^{-1})]/[(1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2})(1-z^{-1})].
Cancel the common factor (1-z^{-1}), and factor the denominator as
1-z^{-1}+(2/9)z^{-2}=(1-z^{-1}/3)(1-2z^{-1}/3),
obtaining
Y(z)= [-(5/3)z^{-1}]/[(1-z^{-1}/3)(1-2z^{-1}/3)].
The partial fraction decomposition is
Y(z)=5/(1-z^{-1}/3)-5/(1-2z^{-1}/3).
Taking the inverse Z-transform gives
 y[n]=5(1/3)^n u[n]-5(2/3)^n u[n].
